[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42827278/a0c61ac528c75df53a04a33d5d8935748ece2702.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your feedback reporting bugs like these and helping improve our game!

notes.title: 2.04 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42827278/ddb902fc0eaa9b1f28af7fa7998ee1382813485a.png[/img]
We've been taking a look at improving stability and have released a small patch focusing on fixing some troublesome crashes. 

Thank you for your feedback and we're looking forward to continued support. 

The 2.04 patch includes the following:
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash on startup that occurred on Windows N and KN versions.
[*] Added a message to crashes caused by corrupt game files that instructs players to verify files and check hardware. This was by far our most common crash, so we hope to elevate this self-fix to all affected users.
[/list]

If you're still experiencing crashes, we hope some of these troubleshooting steps will help you. 
[list]
[*] Verify Integrity of Game Files
[*] Ensure your Graphics driver is up to date
[*] Ensure Windows is up to date
[*] Change between DirectX 11 and 12 (You can run with -dx11 or -dx12 to force on launch)
[*] Enable Windowed Fullscreen mode
[/list]

We always welcome more information on crashes or bugs via email at [noparse]support@emberlab.com[/noparse].

notes.title: 2.03 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42827278/8fd56414574ac01787c76bccf9d4edf356f0252d.jpg[/img]

Happy Friday! We hope you have been enjoying the Anniversary Update for [i]Kena: Bridge of Spirits[/i]. Its been a fun week for us seeing all your amazing new shots captured with the updated photo mode features. We've made several stability improvements and corrected a few bugs in this patch. 

Stay tuned for additional fixes and updates. Thanks for your support and enjoy the adventure!

The 2.03 patch includes the following:
[list]
[*] Fixed issues making it possible to collect more than 100 Rot when replaying the game in New Game+.
[*] Fixed a bug with the Shrine Guardian Combat Reflection Trial that prevented the bonus objective "Cleansing Strike" from being awarded.
[*] Crash fixes.
[*] Kena Outfit animation improvements and fixes.
[*] Fixed issue allowing the Woodknight to attack during spawn animation.
[/list]

notes.title: Kena Photo Mode Features and Updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42827278/a525419052343de60795b2677eb784a3c87b93a1.png[/img][previewyoutube=L6JAgb5CTGY;full][/previewyoutube]

Only a few more days before Kena's release on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1954200/Kena_Bridge_of_Spirits/]September 27th[/url] and we can't wait to see what you capture with Photo Mode!

You can activate Photo Mode all along your adventure and capture epic and adorable photos of your journey. Characters (including all the Rot!) will freeze by default once you enter photo mode, but you can “resume action” to bring them back to life. As you move the camera, they will keep their attention on you; following and engaging with the camera as you set up your perfect shot.

For the Anniversary Update, brand new poses have been added and Photo Mode has been enhanced with Lighting Setups, Camera Animation, and more.  You'll also be able to change Kena's outfit to show off your best looks.

notes.title: Anniversary Update Patch Notes 2.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42827278/5d68d9b7fb039caefe04d0148f19e70cc4138db1.png[/img]


To celebrate our upcoming Steam release, the Kena experience has been expanded with many new features including: New Game+, Spirit Guide Trials, Kena Outfits, Charmstones, Accessibility features, and more. We hope you enjoy exploring your journey in Kena’s world!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1954200/Kena_Bridge_of_Spirits/?utm_source=steampatch2.0]Wishlist[/url] now and stay tuned for more updates as we prepare for this exciting Steam launch coming September 27th!

The Anniversary Update with Steam launch includes the following new features and updates:

[b]New Game+[/b]
[list]
[*] New Game+ will become available after completing an initial playthrough – replay the main story while keeping all collected Rot, abilities, and upgrades. 
[*] Most New Game+ combat encounters have been updated with new enemies and modified compositions. 
[*] Special Green Chests with collectibles will become available in New Game+.
[*] Many bosses will include new attacks in New Game+.
[/list]

[b]Spirit Guide Trials & Outfits[/b]
[list]
[*] Spirit Guide Trials offer unique challenges to test your skills and earn rewards. Interact with the carving behind the Mask Shrine to take on new Trials as they become available throughout your adventure.
[*] Unique Kena Outfits with color variants can be unlocked by completing Spirit Guide Trials and Bonus Objectives.
[/list]

[b]Charmstones, Abilities, & Hats[/b]
[list]
[*] Equipable Charmstones have been hidden throughout the world that will modify Kena’s abilities by granting unique combinations of advantages and disadvantages in combat.
[*] Two new Bomb Ability upgrades have been added – Splatter Bomb and Split Bomb.
[*] New Rot Hats have been hidden throughout the world.
[/list]

[b]Enhanced Photo Mode[/b]
[list]
[*] Photo Mode has been enhanced with Lighting Setups, Camera Animation, and more.
[*] Brand new Poses have been added to Photo Mode.
[/list]

[b]Settings[/b]
[list]
[*] Apprentice Spirit Guide, a new difficulty setting, offers a balance between Story Mode and Spirit Guide settings.
[*] Text localization for Polish language has been added.
[*] DLSS and Dynamic Resolution support has been added. (PC Only)
[/list]

[b]Accessibility Features[/b]
[list]
[*] UI scaling.
[*] Automatic sprint.
[*] Subtitle size and background opacity.
[*] Toggle input functionally for multiple abilities.
[/list]

[b]Deluxe Edition:[/b]
[list]
[*] Kena: Bridge of Spirits Original Soundtrack has been expanded and remastered.
[*] The Shadow outfit has been included as a Deluxe Edition exclusive.
[/list]

This patch also includes the following fixes:
[list]
[*] Pre-rendered cutscenes are rendered at higher frame rate to fix frame pacing issues.
[*] Difficulty balancing has been improved.
[/list]
